Safeguarding Code of Conduct for Staff

safety.policy_summary: Harrow International School Bangkok is committed to keeping children safe, expecting all community members, staff, and visitors to share this commitment. The Child Safeguarding Policy outlines commitments, steps taken to keep students safe, and procedures for addressing safety or wellbeing concerns, supported by designated safeguarding leads across school sections.
